whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Banwari Cafe & Restaurant,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.2★ reviews in Indra Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food delivery orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu items, aur operating timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/banwari

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team Banwari Cafe & Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

[If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, and a mobile-first speed optimized for Patna food lovers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?
[If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
